periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the black periocular patches are oriented obliquely, converging at approximately a 45-degree angle toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated elliptical morphology with a length-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: A visible tapering effect is present at the inferior margin, where the patch narrows significantly toward the rostrum.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely spaced, with the lateral gap between the medial edges being approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae show a continuous, smooth semicircular curvature without flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant exposure of the upper and lower incisors and canine teeth, accompanied by visible gingival tissue, resulting from the open-mouth facial posture.
